question: What is the name of India's high-resolution weather forecasting system launched in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Forecasting System**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bharat Forecasting System** is India's advanced **high-resolution weather forecasting system**, launched in **May 2025**.
 
• It is designed to enhance the accuracy of **weather predictions** and provide real-time updates regarding **climatic changes**.
 
• This system utilizes **state-of-the-art technology**, including advanced computational models, satellite data, and artificial intelligence, to improve the precision of forecasts.
 
• The system plays a vital role in **disaster management**, allowing authorities to take timely preventive actions during extreme weather conditions such as cyclones, floods, and heatwaves.
 
• The Bharat Forecasting System is a part of India's commitment to advancing **climate science** and ensuring better preparedness for **climate-related challenges**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **High-Resolution Weather Forecasting:**

 
 
• High-resolution models provide **granular weather data** that is essential for making localized and specific forecasts.
 
• Such systems are crucial for predicting events like **urban flooding**, intense rainfall, and thunderstorms with high accuracy.
 
• They also assist in **agriculture planning** by predicting rainfall patterns, drought conditions, and other climatic factors.
 
 
 
• **Role of Technology in Weather Forecasting:**
 
 
• Advanced computational systems, like **supercomputers**, are integral in running complex weather models.
 
• Use of **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** enhances predictive capabilities by analyzing vast amounts of historical weather data.
 
• Satellite imaging and **remote sensing** enable real-time monitoring of atmospheric conditions.
 
 
 
• **Disaster Management and Weather Forecasting:**
 
 
• Accurate weather forecasting helps in **early warning systems**, reducing the impact of natural disasters on human lives and infrastructure.
 
• It supports the development of contingency plans for events like **cyclones, landslides, and heatwaves**.
 
• Governments can allocate resources efficiently based on **weather predictions**.
 
 
 
• **Global Comparisons:**
 
 
• Countries like the **USA** and **Japan** have already developed advanced weather forecasting systems leveraging **supercomputers** and **AI technologies**.
 
• The **European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)** is known for its high accuracy in global weather predictions.
 
• The Bharat Forecasting System positions India as a leader in **climate technology** in the **Asia-Pacific region**.
